channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Editorial | Minnesota is under siege. This cannot stand.
item.description: ICE presence has disrupted all aspects of life in Minnesota, and led tragically to the death of Renee Good. It’s the outcome of government overreach that favors force over legitimacy.

item.title: Former Vikings WR Adam Thielen makes retirement official: ‘What a ride it’s been’
item.description: Thielen, a Minnesota native, requested to be waived by the Vikings midseason and closed his 13-year career with the Steelers.

item.title: Minnesota’s biggest companies starting to feel heat from ICE surge
item.description: From Target to General Mills and Caribou Coffee, Minnesota’s largest employers are feeling pressure amid a surge of immigration officers in the state following the killing of Renee Good.

item.title: Kiki Rice, Lauren Betts power No. 3 UCLA past Gophers 76-58
item.description: The Gophers, after ending a 36-game losing streak against ranked foes with a win over No. 21 USC on Jan. 11, couldn’t keep up with the Bruins.

item.title: Fatal ICE shooting shakes up races for U.S. Senate, governor
item.description: Democrats are battling over past immigration votes in Minnesota’s open U.S. Senate seat, while Republicans in the party’s crowded field for governor attempt to lay the blame for the shooting on Democratic politicians.

item.title: Justice Department sues Minnesota over affirmative action policies
item.description: Minnesota’s Department of Human Services requires supervisors to provide a justification when hiring a candidate who is not in a minority group.

item.title: Ramstad: The response to fraud in Minnesota is now overkill
item.description: Minnesotans are being terrorized by ICE. As funding delays ruin caregiving businesses and charities, those who depend on human services worry about losing them.

item.title: Minnesota medical transportation program faces new scrutiny
item.description: Providers and prosecutors have seen issues in the Medicaid-funded nonemergency medical transportation program for years. It’s the subject of a new video by conservative influencer Nick Shirley.

item.title: Renee Good came to Minneapolis seeking a safe place. Less than a year later, she was killed.
item.description: After years as a military wife, Good was starting over when an encounter with ICE agents cut her new life short.

item.title: The latest: Federal officer shoots man in Minneapolis after authorities say agent was ‘attacked’ with shovel
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security said a federal law enforcement officer is in the hospital after being attacked by a shovel. A car chase followed a “targeted” traffic stop.
